meta.tldr: Aider 0.86.0 introduces expanded model support, now including all GPT-5 models, Grok-4 via `xai/grok-4` and `openrouter/x-ai/grok-4`, `gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17`, and `openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2`. These additions provide developers with a wider array of powerful AI models to leverage in their coding workflows, enhancing flexibility and access to cutting-edge capabilities. The `/clear` command now provides explicit confirmation with "All chat history cleared.", improving user feedback and clarity. The `/undo` command's output has been refined to show only the first line of each commit message, making it significantly easier to parse and understand the impact of an undo operation. A new feature allows displaying model announcements by simply running the `/model` command without any arguments, providing quick access to important updates or information about available models. This release also fixes a critical issue where new settings for an existing model would not correctly replace old ones, ensuring that model configurations are applied as expected. Analytics have been updated to support the latest PostHog SDK event-capture API, and dependencies have been bumped to `litellm==1.75.0` for improved stability and features. Developers should upgrade to take advantage of the new model integrations and improved command-line experience.
